independence.method: Sequential passes by one agent, as assigned. Task-first was written before baseline/evidence were opened. No pass rankings or selected portfolio existed when passes A-D were generated. A single context cannot guarantee cognitive independence; this is not represented as fresh-context multi-agent generation.

evidence_readout.fact: Full official evaluator has fixture distinctions from the proxy; sample score difference on four fixed predictions was zero. This is evaluator validation, not model quality evidence.

Flat mother-daughter set prediction recovers no divisions in either outer fold or 117 covered training divisions. All 128 covered outer true pairs lose to their own singleton/empty subset, but 42 true pairs rank best among pairs. Candidate coverage 107/108 and 21/22 leaves substantial representational headroom; less pruning alone does not solve collapsed cardinality.

Historical-feature tracker pair gate fails both folds. Sparse teacher audit has 97.71% unknown endpoints among active pairs and uses 5um greedy matching, which is not the official 7um optimal matching. Window filtering excludes 994 windows based on GT availability, a train-only selection condition.
Fixed-feature coordinate head reduces mean matched center distance from 1.8214 to 1.5162um on 20 video-grouped conditional comparisons; no official graph score is in that coordinate validation.

Frozen refined route beats zero route in official aggregate score 0.8903485 vs 0.8792390 on 20 videos, while node recall falls by 0.00271. Six 6bba videos worsen adjusted edge Jaccard. Coordinate/feature routes remain unseparated; 183 known edge changes in 18 videos trigger an unrun diagnostic.

Expanding fixed-score edge candidates improves node recall but worsens official aggregate score to 0.8780877; both embryo aggregate scores decrease. All expanded ILPs are optimal. 904102 vs 547895 candidate edges; maximum solve 814.08s, total expanded ILP 2578.79s, peak memory 22.39GB.

Adding past feature attention reduces known-edge recall from public primary 0.95760 to 0.92853 on 44b6 and 0.96440 to 0.95450 on 6bba. On 44b6 observable false edges fall 243 to 172, and top-1 known-parent counts change only 3189 to 3185. All-past-masked outputs nearly match the history model; added history as direct tracker input has little isolated support.

547 new known candidate edges, of which 360 are rejected by ILP: 228 higher-score competing parents, 34 lower-score competing parents, 98 no selected parent. 81 rejected known edges are rank1. All 9 new known divisions select only one daughter. Eleven forced ILPs remain optimal with objective penalties 0.01956-2.54623. The downstream objective, not solely candidate availability or suboptimal solve, can reject known truth.

same_entity_context.available: The same hidden sequence supplies unlabeled images, detections, edge scores and history. No GEFF labels, estimated node count or guaranteed neighboring field-of-view overlap is available at test time.
same_entity_context.reference: Estimate robust physical displacement and residual dispersion in spatial/time neighborhoods from uncontested frozen links. Use a common physical coordinate system and query a sequence-local reference at each ambiguous endpoint.
roles_compared: Reference to subtract local common motion
Observation model via local residual dispersion
Downstream calibration feature via support size
Gate via context coverage; no updating frozen tracker
same_entity_context.coverage_and_fallback: Require disjoint support links outside the repaired motif, minimum empirically fixed training-side support and stable residual estimation. Outside support or at short/missing/boundary context, exactly copy anchor.
same_entity_context.not_assumed: No embryo-specific labeled support set, global motion conservation, known test cardinality or dense annotation.

imperfect_intermediate_training.applicable: A downstream graph refiner receives fallible outputs of frozen image/coordinate/tracker models. Clean GEFF motifs would make conditioning unrealistically easy.
closed_design: Training-side video out-of-fold-like frozen predictions measure signed coordinate bias, temporal error autocorrelation, missing nodes/links, score-ranking swaps, singleton-for-division inversion and density-dependent error rates.
Construct synthetic conditioning from verified sparse motifs, replay those correlated corruption processes while retaining immutable known graph labels and masking unknown surrounding truth.
Pretrain only a downstream local event/graph-edit scorer to repair synthetic errors.
Fine-tune briefly on real training-side held-out-video conditioning; choose stages and gates inside the training embryo.
Evaluate uncorrupted real frozen conditioning on the other embryo in each direction, conditional on shared public pretrained models.
kills: Synthetic and real error amplitudes/correlation disagree
Unrealistic matching uses clean locations unavailable at test
Known edge or observable false-edge gate worsens either embryo
Full official score or 12h inference contract fails
imperfect_intermediate_training.limitation: Observed OOF-like intermediate corruption is conditional, not independent image-model OOF. Sparse labels only characterize observable error subsets.

known_relations: Rigid coordinate relabeling preserves distances and graph topology
A division event jointly contains two daughter links
empirical_relations_to_test: Local motion residual variance after robust same-sequence subtraction
Single-cell acceleration distribution outside observed divisions
Relative pair separation derivative before/after candidate division
invariant_discovery.cheap_EDA: Compute robust quantiles and variance by embryo, time, local density and boundary distance on known GEFF motifs and frozen predictions. Compare with sequence-shuffled references. Reject any relation whose residual tails or support depend strongly on embryo before using it as a prior.
invariant_discovery.preserved: Graph topology and physical units under graph-coordinate relabeling; verified parent-child teachers under synthetic errors.
invariant_discovery.deliberately_broken: Conditioning coordinates, link presence and score order under calibrated deployment corruptions.
invariant_discovery.recomputation: Recompute candidate distances, neighborhood membership and derived kinematics after perturbation. If images/crops/time windows change, fixed image features must be re-extracted; graph-only augmentation excludes appearance features rather than pretending equivariance.
invariant_discovery.rejected_invariants: Cell count, fluorescence mass and exact mother-to-daughter barycenter equality are not established invariants in finite fields of view.

A_representation.definition: Separate event cardinality from daughter-set ranking, with complete division-versus-own-subset comparisons and explicit unknown-label masks; decode compatible events, not independent edge probabilities.
Retain a distribution over compatible local subgraphs from near-optimal alternative solves, then resolve event uncertainty using temporal support.
Treat tracklet identity permutations across four frames as the output and rank complete swaps/retentions with trajectory continuity.
Maximize likelihood summed over graph completions compatible with observed sparse positives; annotate lower bounds on cardinality instead of forcing missing edges to negatives.
Represent a short mother/daughters trajectory motif with pre-branch/post-branch latent states; rank daughter separation over time rather than one two-frame edge.
Raw-image displacement distributions jointly generate nodes and identities; needs new image-model learning and is policy-deferred.

B_information_invariance.definition: Move reliable same-sequence link histories into a physical motion reference and an uncertainty reference with context coverage fallback.
Move zero-versus-refined coordinate disagreement into downstream reliability/calibration; never average coordinates before matching.
Use stored past feature consistency as evidence for a decision to preserve or reconsider an edge, without entering or updating the tracker.
Use failed set model pair-conditional rankings as a candidate prior while removing its collapsed cardinality normalization; obtain score/cache availability before reuse.
Correlated measured graph-conditioning corruption, synthetic repair pretraining, real OOF-like refinement and untouched outer-embryo evaluation form one proposal.
Graph-coordinate rigid relabeling plus observation-score corruption trains a geometry-only event scorer; invariant teachers stay fixed and all geometric derived inputs are recomputed.

C_candidate_uncertainty.definition: Keep baseline and permissive scored edge/event pools distinct, estimate distributions over compatible whole events and only then decode the pooled graph.
Select one of baseline/expanded/zero-refined complete graph routes using observable density, support and disagreement; train selection on nested train-side groups.
Fuse event marginal distributions before selection, comparing with hard-route selection and entropy-gated anchor preservation; correlated candidates are not counted as independent evidence.
Add contextual candidates only around components where existing solutions disagree, exposing compute cost separately from oracle recovery.
Construct independent raw-image temporal foreground components as a separate candidate generator; accept only if held-group oracle node/edge coverage and target-free graph selectability both improve.
Use non-best zero-coordinate or failed history route only where its residual errors differ from anchor; raw average of incompatible graph rows is disallowed.

D_validation_compute.definition: Partition the optimizer by the full variable/constraint incidence graph, caching unchanged components and preserving exact objective. Speed gain enables compatible multi-event exchanges in previously expensive ambiguous regions.
Cross coordinate geometry with frozen feature-sampling location and lock candidate identities to isolate geometry, score and evaluator matching routes behind coordinate correction.
Stress hidden availability, context length, density and cardinality using no-label inference; verify deterministic anchor fallback and measured per-sequence runtime.
Compute event-level oracle constrained by actual candidate identities, then test target-free selectors on separately held groups; official score and observable partial-label errors remain distinct.
Replace GT-dependent input-window exclusion with prediction-defined coverage auditing, preserving teacher masks and reporting previously excluded contexts.

combinations.result: I01: Complete division/continuation events with separate cardinality score and candidate-relative daughter ranking; ambiguous components only. Pair-ranking reuse is optional and never trusts collapsed old set logits.
I02: Same-sequence reference conditions event displacement/dispersion with fallback; future raw sequence observation is allowed, hidden labels are not.
I03: Train repairs on correlated imperfect graph conditioning, retain uncertainty and refine with real frozen inputs before separate outer evaluation.
I04: Soft whole-event pool from baseline/permissive scored candidates; disagreement is confidence evidence, not unconditional expanded-edge replacement.
I05: Exact component caching enables multi-event exchanges; accepted only with end-to-end official accuracy evidence for that enabled algorithm.
I10: Graph-only geometry augmentation and observation corruption, omitting unsupported encoder equivariance.

cross_combination.hundred_times_faster_counterfactual: With 100x faster graph work, enumerate multiple compatible event alternatives and two-event identity swaps, retaining marginals instead of greedy pairwise choice. No 100x claim is made; I05 has a measured speed gate.

TF05 is an independent learned image displacement-distribution route, deferred for policy change. These are not covertly replaced by frozen point features.
